result.title: Consensus Within, Competition Between: Decentralized LLM Teams for Perimeter Defense
result.comment: 88 pages (33 main text and references, 55 supplementary material), 7 main figures. Code: https://github.com/the-kas-lab/consensus-within-competition-between
result.summary: The use of large language models (LLMs) to coordinate multi-agent teams raises a fundamental architectural question: whether task allocation should be centralized in a single LLM controller or distributed across autonomous LLM agents, particularly when communication is unreliable. In a deliberately simplified perimeter-defense simulation against LLM-controlled intruders, we compared a central commander, an auction-based consensus team and independent agents under five network conditions. Breach rates were 15% for the consensus team, 32% for the commander and 29% for independent agents, and of the different network conditions, only limited radio range changed a team's breach rate, raising the commander's. In consensus team, giving a low-cost LLM more authority over the bid computation raised breaches by 38 percentage points. With birds and civilian drones in airspace, we added a photograph for each to the input text state. Only the near-frontier model treated them apart from intruders. Intruders disguised as existing taxidermy bird drones were mistook as birds by both low-cost and near-frontier LLMs, going unpursued in 59-61% of near-frontier decisions (1-16% before). However, a one-sentence forewarning in the prompt lowered it to 0-25%. We find that LLM team with a dedicated external conflict resolution protocol results in fewest breaches. Code: https://github.com/the-kas-lab/consensus-within-competition-between.

AI.brief_summary: 在简化的周界防御仿真中比较集中式指挥官、拍卖式共识团队与独立 LLM 智能体在五种网络条件下的拦截表现，并向文本状态加入鸟与民用无人机照片，考察模型的视觉区分及一句提示预警的影响。
AI.relevance_reason: 照片加入后模型仍把伪装入侵者判为鸟、提示预警又大幅降低该错误，这一现象可能为核查「视觉证据是否真正进入决策状态、语言先验是否压制视觉判断」提供旁证线索；但论文主体是多智能体协调架构而非 latent 视觉推理，视觉部分较浅，需较多核查。
